intro1: Spalding’s mix of riverside Georgian houses, bungalows and new estates means no two rooms are alike, so everything we make is built to measure.
intro2: We design fitted kitchens, wardrobes, bedrooms and storage around how your household lives, from family kitchens with plenty of worktop and larder space to wall-to-wall wardrobes that keep bedrooms clear. Spalding is around 18 miles from our Peterborough workshop.
sty: Tall larder units in a Victorian kitchen, bedroom furniture for a bungalow or sliding wardrobes on a new estate: each piece is made for its room.
proc_lead: Making takes four to six weeks once you approve the design. Spalding is 30 to 35 minutes away via the A16, part of our regular area.
steps: We measure carefully, because older fenland homes have often moved over the years and floors and walls are rarely level. Free, with no obligation.

bk: Send us some photos on WhatsApp or book a visit. We’ll come to your Spalding home, measure up and send you a 3D design with an itemised quote, free and with no obligation.
det: Our showroom and workshop are in Peterborough, around 18 miles from Spalding. As well as Spalding itself, we design and fit in Pinchbeck, Weston, Cowbit and Deeping St Nicholas. We cover homes up to 80 miles from Peterborough, so if you’re further out, call 01733 686767 and we’ll tell you straight away.
faqs: Do you cover Spalding and the South Holland villages?
Yes. Spalding is about 18 miles from our workshop, usually 30 to 35 minutes via the A16 through Crowland, and we fit across Pinchbeck, Weston, Cowbit and Deeping St Nicholas too.
My floors and walls aren’t level. Is that a problem?
No. It’s common in older fenland properties. We allow for it when we measure and use adjustable legs, scribed fillers and made-to-measure panels so everything sits straight.
Do you make fitted furniture for bungalows?
Yes. Fitted bedroom furniture, hallway storage and kitchens with everything at a comfortable working height are some of our most common jobs in Spalding bungalows.
How much does a fitted kitchen cost in Spalding?
Straightforward fitted kitchens start from around £5,000. Larger layouts, premium worktops and appliances cost more. The itemised quote after your free survey breaks it all down.
Can I see your work before booking?
Yes. Our showroom is at 3 Brassey Close, Peterborough PE1 2AZ. Call 01733 686767 to arrange a visit, or ask to see photos of similar jobs when we come out.
